headline: EPS rises on both comparisons
summary_short: KDDI reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥51.34, up 19.4% y/y from ¥43.01.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥51.34 rose 19.4% year-over-year from ¥43.01, and was up 20.9% sequentially from ¥42.45 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data.
